sourceRefs.locator: Opening paragraphs, p. 65 and notes 1–2: recall from Hispania, Aquitanica Secunda and neighbouring cities, Toulouse and the open question of settlement density

summary.de: Der Heermeister veranlasste 418 die Rückkehr gotischer Truppen aus Hispanien und ihre Ansiedlung in Gallien.
summary.en: The commander arranged the recall of Gothic troops from Hispania in 418 and their settlement in Gaul.
